label: Meshtastic Nodes → TAK
info:
Meshtastic radios in Tennessee (plus a small buffer) that publish their position to the public Meshtastic MQTT server, shown with their node names. Only nodes whose owners turned on MQTT uplink or map reports appear, and only the default public LongFast channel is decoded.

Data: Meshtastic public MQTT server (https://meshtastic.org/docs/software/integrations/mqtt/). Updates every live (as nodes report; markers stay 60 minutes).

Needs: [node-red-contrib-meshtastic-advanced](https://flows.nodered.org/node/node-red-contrib-meshtastic-advanced) (Manage palette > Install).

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Edit the Meshtastic public MQTT broker, open Security, and enter the public login meshdev / large4cats (the published login for mqtt.meshtastic.org).
3. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/meshtastic
